subject: Use excel file from PC on shiny server

messages.author: 08235c2e1d3f66d5
messages.subject: Use excel file from PC on shiny server
parts:
My app runs fine locally and I am able to successfully deploy my app to the shinyapps.io server, but I get the following error message when I try and load the app in my browser using the shinyapps URL: "Error object 'data' not found.' I think this is because the 'data' variable reads from a csv file on my local directory. Is there a way I can upload this csv file to the shinyapps server? I've tried looking this up but I've found nothing.

Thanks

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Use excel file from PC on shiny server
parts:
Hello Vatsal,
I am suspecting that your csv file is not in the same directory as your app.R or ui.R/server.R.  Your application needs to be loading the data by relative paths.  Please see this section of the documentation which can hopefully help:

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#debugging-your-application

Best,
Tareef
